files_modified.behavior_after: Reads reports/<slug>-dispatch.json, launches Codex CLI agents (up to --parallel-limit, default 2), polls for valid JSON output per agent (POLL_INTERVAL=15s), retries timed-out agents once, calls merge_agent_outputs.py <slug> --expected-agents <all-runnable-agent-ids> (populates agents_missing in merge output), writes reports/<slug>-merge-ready sentinel. On all-agents-fail: invokes run-phase2.sh <slug> fallback with set+e isolation; failure log entry includes structured multi_agent_fallback:true field. Logs all failures to reports/logs/<slug>-failures.json. Bash 3.2 compatible (no mapfile, no declare -A — uses per-agent temp files).
Pipeline usage guide: automation mode, manual mode, dispatch config format, option reference, output file table, parallel limit guidance, monitoring commands.

Per-condition failure handling reference: timeout (1x retry), invalid JSON (reject + continue), missing output (skip + continue), missing input/empty IR slice (skip at start), all agents failed (orchestrator auto-invokes run-phase2.sh fallback; multi_agent_fallback:true as JSON boolean in failure log; exit 0 if fallback ok, exit 2 if fallback fails), merge failure (exit 1, no sentinel), verify fail (out of scope — Session 21).

deviations_from_spec: Codex CLI invocation flags (--input/--output) are placeholder — exact CLI interface not documented in multi-agent-plan.md:400-520. Adjust to actual Codex CLI interface when known.

findings_addressed: [P1] Bash 3.2 portability: replaced declare -A with temp-file state, replaced mapfile with while-read loop
[P1] Output filename double-prefix: agent_output_file() was reports/<slug>-agent-${agent}.json (→ ...-agent-agent-a1.json); fixed to reports/<slug>-${agent}.json (→ ...-agent-a1.json)
[P2] All-agents-fail invoked run-phase2.sh but set -e caused it to exit before custom handler; also multi_agent_fallback was text-only
[P1] merge_agent_outputs.py called without --expected-agents — agents_missing always empty; fixed by passing all AGENTS_TO_RUN as --expected-agents
[P2] Fallback exit code leaked through set -e — wrapped fallback call with set +e / set -e for correct exit 2 on failure
[P2b] multi_agent_fallback only in free-text impact string — added as structured boolean field in failure log JSON
[P3] Manifest was pre-fix state — updated to reflect final post-review-2 implementation

[P3] FAILURE-MODES.md Section 5 still described pre-fix all-agents-fail behavior (exit 2, manual fallback). Synced to actual behavior: auto-invokes run-phase2.sh, writes multi_agent_fallback:true as structured JSON boolean, exits 0 on fallback success / 2 on fallback failure. Quick Reference table updated accordingly.
